from pathlib import Path
import collections,hashlib,json
R=Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize');C=Path('/private/tmp/zstdoxide-tree-families-2026-10-13')
manifest=json.loads((R/'tests/fixtures/reference-tree-family-recipes/recipes.json').read_text())
rows=[];groups=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for case in manifest['recipes']:
 if case['family'] in ('tiny-control','long-periodic-frontier'):continue
 name=case['name'];h=case['hypothesis'];data=(C/('logs/normal-case-'+name+'.stdout')).read_bytes()
 records=[json.loads(line) for line in data.splitlines()]
 record=next(r for r in records if r.get('record')=='operation' and r['pass']==0 and r['query']==h['query'])
 length,offset=record['length'],record['offset_base'];distance=offset-3 if length else None
 classification='zero' if length==0 else 'other'
 if case['family']=='conditional-offset-cost':
  if (distance,length)==(h['near_distance'],h['near_length']):classification='near'
  if (distance,length)==(h['far_distance'],h['far_length']):classification='far'
  group='cost-gain-minus-cost-'+str(h['gain_minus_cost'])
 elif case['family']=='node-floor':group='node-distance-minus-count-'+str(h['far_distance']-h['node_count'])
 elif case['family']=='window-floor':group='window-delta-'+str(h['window_delta'])
 else:group=case['family']
 groups[group][f'{classification}:length={length}']+=1
 rows.append(dict(name=name,family=case['family'],hypothesis=h,length=length,offset_base=offset,distance=distance,classification=classification,stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()))
report=dict(status='passed',scope='Observed first-padding normal query results only; sanitized and padding equivalence belongs to the capture auditor. Conditional hypotheses do not imply an internal comparison-order witness.',groups=dict(groups),records=rows)
Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-tree-family-outcomes.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report['groups'],sort_keys=True))
